Name: Bulbasaur
Effects: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients that are packed into the seed on its back in order to grow.

Name: Ivysaur
Effects: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

Name: Venusaur
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: While it basks in the sun, it can convert the light into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

Name: Exeggcute
Effects: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: If you touch one of Exeggcute’s heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

Name: Alolan Exeggutor ex
Effects: 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon is chosen at random. This attack also does 50 damage to it.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Pinsir
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

Name: Combee
Flavor-Text: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

Name: Vespiquen
Effects: Reveal all of the Sweet Honey in your hand, and this attack does 50 damage for each card you revealed in this way.
Flavor-Text: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

Name: Deerling
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon are not shy—they will behave as they please, even in front of people. If you feed one of them, it will quickly take a liking to you.

Name: Sawsbuck
Effects: Discard a [G] Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: There are many Sawsbuck enthusiasts. The darker the red of the foliage that hangs from its antlers, the more stylish the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

Name: Foongus
Flavor-Text: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

Name: Amoonguss
Effects: Look at a random card from your opponent's hand and shuffle it into their deck.
Flavor-Text: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss’s caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

Name: Genesect
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
Flavor-Text: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

Name: Cutiefly
Flavor-Text: When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon who are having fun, it will draw close and give them a painful poke with its long proboscis.

Name: Ribombee
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Put a rental card into your hand.
Flavor-Text: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.

Name: Charmander
Effects: Discard a [R] Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

Name: Charmeleon
Flavor-Text: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

Name: Charizard
Ability-Effect: Whenever you attach a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone to this Pokémon, do 30 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: If Charizard becomes truly angered, the flame at the tip of its tail burns in a light blue shade.

Name: Volcanion
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 110 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

Name: Salandit
Flavor-Text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

Name: Salazzle
Flavor-Text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

Name: Scorbunny
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: Once its body has heated up, Scorbunny can use the full extent of its power. That’s why it does warm-up exercises.

Name: Raboot
Ability-Effect: As long as this Pokémon is in play, flip 3 more coins for the Rabbit Jumping attack used by your Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily heat up its fire energy and produce flames with more power.

Name: Cinderace
Effects: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
Flavor-Text: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

Name: Fuecoco ex
Effects: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 70 more damage.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Charcadet
Flavor-Text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

Name: Armarouge
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
Flavor-Text: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

Name: Ceruledge
Effects: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 70 more damage.
Flavor-Text: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

Name: Squirtle
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
Flavor-Text: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It sprays a potent foam from its mouth.

Name: Wartortle
Flavor-Text: Wartortle’s long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, so this Pokémon is quite popular among older people.

Name: Blastoise
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, you may take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It deliberately increases its body weight so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

Name: Seel
Flavor-Text: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

Name: Dewgong
Effects: Discard 2 [W] Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 60 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it’s colder.

Name: Shellder
Flavor-Text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

Name: Cloyster
Effects: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

Name: Jynx
Flavor-Text: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

Name: Lapras
Effects: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

Name: Palkia
Effects: If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it.
Flavor-Text: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

Name: Basculin
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon form schools with others of the same color. The greatest foe of a school of blue Basculin is a school of red Basculin.

Name: Froakie
Flavor-Text: Its happy-go-lucky look is an act intended to fool its enemies. It will suddenly drop the facade and overwhelm its foes with its blinding speed.

Name: Frogadier
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this card from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Put a random Frogadier from your deck onto your Bench.
Flavor-Text: It excels at devising battle strategies that make use of the terrain, and it never misses its mark when throwing bubble-covered pebbles.

Name: Mega Greninja ex
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
Ex-Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 3 points.

Name: Pikachu ex
Effects: Discard 2 [L] Energy from this Pokémon.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Voltorb
Flavor-Text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

Name: Electrode
Effects: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.
Flavor-Text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

Name: Stunfisk
Flavor-Text: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

Name: Zeraora
Effects: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

Name: Pawmi
Flavor-Text: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

Name: Pawmo
Flavor-Text: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

Name: Pawmot
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, you may take a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to the [L] Pokémon in the Active Spot.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

Name: Jigglypuff
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. Your opponent flips 2 coins for this Special Condition, and if either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.
Flavor-Text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

Name: Wigglytuff
Effects: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

Name: Abra
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

Name: Kadabra
Flavor-Text: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

Name: Alakazam
Effects: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

Name: Mega Mewtwo X ex
Effects: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 40 more damage.
Ex-Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 3 points.

Name: Mew ex
Effects: Flip 3 coins. Take an amount of [P] Energy from your Energy Zone equal to the number of heads and attach it to your Benched [P] Pokémon in any way you like.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Marill
Flavor-Text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

Name: Azumarill
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

Name: Espeon
Effects: This attack does 20 more damage for each [P] Energy attached to this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.

Name: Wobbuffet
Flavor-Text: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

Name: Deoxys
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psycho Boost does −50 damage.
Flavor-Text: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

Name: Mimikyu
Effects: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 30 more damage.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

Name: Cosmog
Effects: Draw a card.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

Name: Cosmoem
Flavor-Text: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon’s growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

Name: Lunala
Effects: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
Flavor-Text: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

Name: Diglett
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

Name: Dugtrio
Effects: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

Name: Rhyhorn
Flavor-Text: Rhyhorn claims an area with over a six mile radius as its territory. It apparently forgets where this territory is when running, however.

Name: Rhydon
Effects: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
Flavor-Text: The horn of a Rhydon is powerful enough to crush raw diamonds. These Pokémon polish their horns by bashing them together.

Name: Rhyperior
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon’s sturdy carapace protects it from volcanic eruptions. It shoots round rocks from the holes in its hands.

Name: Sudowoodo
Flavor-Text: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

Name: Paldean Wooper
Flavor-Text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

Name: Paldean Clodsire
Effects: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

Name: Larvitar
Flavor-Text: Born deep underground, this Pokémon  becomes a pupa after eating enough  dirt to make a mountain.

Name: Pupitar
Effects: Take 2 [F] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

Name: Barboach
Flavor-Text: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.

Name: Whiscash
Effects: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra [F] Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

Name: Rockruff
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

Name: Lycanroc ex
Ability-Effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 30 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Gastly
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
Flavor-Text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

Name: Haunter
Flavor-Text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

Name: Gengar
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Asleep.
Flavor-Text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

Name: Umbreon
Effects: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.
Flavor-Text: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

Name: Mega Tyranitar ex
Effects: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
Ex-Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 3 points.

Name: Seviper
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
Flavor-Text: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

Name: Zorua
Flavor-Text: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

Name: Zoroark
Effects: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
Flavor-Text: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.

Name: Nickit
Flavor-Text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

Name: Thievul
Flavor-Text: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

Name: Mega Skarmory ex
Effects: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.
Ex-Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 3 points.

Name: Dialga
Effects: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
Flavor-Text: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

Name: Ferroseed
Flavor-Text: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn’t very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

Name: Ferrothorn
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

Name: Solgaleo
Effects: This attack does 30 more damage for each point you have gotten.
Flavor-Text: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

Name: Meltan
Flavor-Text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

Name: Melmetal
Ability-Effect: As long as this Pokémon is in play, all of your [M] Pokémon take −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon. This effect doesn't stack.
Flavor-Text: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

Name: Dratini
Flavor-Text: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

Name: Dragonair
Flavor-Text: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

Name: Mega Dragonite ex
Effects: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random. Do 250 damage to it.
Ex-Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 3 points.

Name: Giratina ex
Effects: Discard 2 random Energy from this Pokémon.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Pidgey
Effects: Put 1 random [C] Pokémon from your deck into your hand.
Flavor-Text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

Name: Pidgeotto
Flavor-Text: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

Name: Pidgeot
Effects: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.
Flavor-Text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

Name: Spearow
Flavor-Text: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

Name: Fearow
Flavor-Text: Carrying food through Fearow’s territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

Name: Eevee
Effects: Put a random card that evolves from Eevee from your deck into your hand.
Flavor-Text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

Name: Porygon
Effects: Discard a random Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It is an artificial Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are excited by its potential to be useful in any environment.

Name: Porygon2
Flavor-Text: This artificial Pokémon evolved thanks to cutting- edge science. It sometimes displays behavior that is not in its programming.

Name: Porygon-Z
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overdrive Smash attack does +50 damage.
Flavor-Text: An additional program was installed to create a more advanced Pokémon, but it was apparently flawed. Porygon-Z moves oddly as a result.

Name: Snorlax
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
Flavor-Text: This gluttonous Pokémon eats constantly, apart from when it’s asleep. It devours nearly 900 pounds of food per day.

Name: Zangoose
Ability-Effect: This Pokémon can't be affected by any Special Conditions.
Flavor-Text: It’s Seviper’s archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

Name: Bidoof
Flavor-Text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

Name: Bibarel
Flavor-Text: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

Name: Buneary
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

Name: Lopunny
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

Name: Stufful
Flavor-Text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

Name: Bewear ex
Effects: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 100 more damage.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Sweet Honey
Description: Choose 1 of your Pokémon, and then flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, heal 20 damage from that Pokémon.

Name: Super Potion
Description: Heal 40 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard a random Energy from that Pokémon.

Name: Max Repel
Description: Switch out your opponent's Active Stage 2 Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

Name: Full Heal
Description: Your Active Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

Name: Eviolite
Description: The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to takes −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

Name: Light Ball
Description: Attacks used by the Pikachu ex this card is attached to do +30 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

Name: Lorelei
Description: During this turn, attacks used by your Dewgong, Cloyster, or Lapras do +30 damage to your opponent's Pokémon.

Name: Blue's Provocation
Description: You can use this card only if you have Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise, or Pidgeot in play. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

Name: Serena's Choice
Description: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Shuffle  back into your deck.

Name: Rika
Description: Produce 2 [F] Energy from your Energy Zone, and attach it to 1 of your Whiscash or Paldean Clodsire.

Name: Poké Mart Guy
Description: Put 2 random cards from among Super Potion, Max Repel, and Full Heal from your deck into your hand.

Name: Rising Star
Description: You can use this card only if you have 3 or more different Pokémon types in play. Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

Name: Abandoned Station
Description: Once during each player's turn, that player may use this effect. Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.
